choice.purpose: Let a learner choose the one correct option from a closed set.

field_guidance.options: Stable ids, parallel grammatical form. Give each wrong option an explanation naming the misconception it reveals.
field_guidance.correct_option_id: Must equal the id of exactly one declared option.
field_guidance.presentation: 'image' renders options as pictures; evaluation is identical, so do not author a separate kind for it.

requires: at least two options with unique non-empty ids
exactly one correct_option_id, and it must name a declared option
keyboard-operable option selection
negative_cases: correct_option_id naming an option that is not declared
a distractor no learner would choose

options.explanation: Mass is not drawn from soil.

options.text: From carbon dioxide in the air

multi-select.purpose: Let a learner choose every option that satisfies the prompt.

field_guidance.options: Independent candidates. Do not include an option that implies another.
field_guidance.correct_option_ids: Two or more declared option ids. A single correct id belongs to the choice kind instead.

requires: at least two options with unique non-empty ids
every correct_option_id must name a declared option
no duplicate ids in the learner response
negative_cases: duplicate selected ids in a response
a selected id that is not a declared option

fill-blank.purpose: Have a learner supply the missing terms inside a given structure.

field_guidance.answers: One entry per blank, in reading order. Use an array for a blank with genuine alternatives.
field_guidance.blank_ids: Stable ids so per-blank feedback survives a re-render.
field_guidance.case_sensitive: Leave false unless capitalisation is the thing being assessed. Answers are compared after trimming and whitespace collapsing.

requires: one accepted-answer entry per blank
blank_ids, when present, must be unique and match the answer count
the response must carry exactly one value per blank
negative_cases: a blank whose accepted answer is empty
a response with fewer values than declared blanks

numeric.purpose: Collect a numeric answer and score it within a declared tolerance.

field_guidance.value: The exact expected value. NaN and infinity are rejected.
field_guidance.tolerance: Absolute tolerance, never negative. Use 0 for an exact answer; do not use tolerance to hide an unclear question.
field_guidance.unit: State the unit the learner should answer in. The evaluator compares magnitudes only; it does not convert units.

requires: a finite target value
a non-negative finite tolerance when tolerance is given
a finite numeric response

short-response.purpose: Collect a short written answer, scored against declared accepted answers or read by a teacher.

field_guidance.evaluation: 'accepted-answers' for a term, name or short phrase. 'teacher-review' for anything the learner reasons out.
field_guidance.accepted_answers: Every wording that should score as correct, including common synonyms. Compared after trimming, whitespace collapsing and case folding.
field_guidance.review_guidance: What the teacher should look for. Only meaningful under teacher-review.
field_guidance.case_sensitive: Enable only when capitalisation is itself the answer.
field_guidance.max_words: Advisory ceiling shown to the learner. It bounds the input, it does not affect scoring.

requires: evaluation must be 'accepted-answers' or 'teacher-review'
accepted-answers mode requires a non-empty, normalization-unique accepted_answers list
teacher-review mode must not complete on correctness
negative_cases: a numeric value supplied instead of text semantics
accepted-answers mode with an empty accepted_answers list
accepted answers that collide after normalization

examples.review_guidance: Look for a stated mechanism linking light energy to glucose.

match-pairs.purpose: Have a learner connect each item to its counterpart.

field_guidance.pairs: Each entry links one source id to one target id. Source ids must be unique; a repeated source has no single answer.

requires: unique source ids
every submitted link must reference a declared source and a declared target
no source may be submitted twice
negative_cases: duplicate source ids in the config
a link naming a target that is not declared

classify.purpose: Have a learner assign each item to exactly one named category.

field_guidance.pairs: One entry per item: `left` is the item id, `right` is its single category id. The evaluator scores one point per correct assignment.
field_guidance.categories: Declare the category ids and labels the learner chooses between.

requires: single-category membership per item
unique item ids
every submitted assignment must name a declared item and a declared category
negative_cases: an item assigned to two categories
an assignment naming an undeclared category

sequence.purpose: Let a learner reconstruct a defensible order.

field_guidance.order: The one accepted order, as item ids. Alternative valid orders are not supported.
field_guidance.items: Labels shown to the learner, keyed by the same ids used in `order`.

requires: unique item ids
the expected order must cover every item exactly once
the response must be a permutation of the declared items
negative_cases: a response shorter than the declared order
a response containing an item that is not declared

image-hotspot.purpose: Have a learner identify the correct region of a given visual.

field_guidance.image: Reference an asset that already exists. Never describe an image that was not produced.
field_guidance.regions: Percentages of the asset’s intrinsic box, origin top-left. Coordinates must be verified against the actual asset, not estimated.

requires: an existing asset id with alt text
at least two regions with unique ids and coordinates inside the asset box
correct_option_id naming a declared region
negative_cases: regions estimated from an unrelated image

asset_requirements.identity: An existing asset id. An unresolved asset is a tracked dependency, not a blank render.
asset_requirements.coordinate_system: percentage of intrinsic asset box, origin top-left

drag-label.purpose: Have a learner attach each label to its correct target on a visual.

field_guidance.pairs: `left` is the label id, `right` is the target id it belongs to.
field_guidance.image: Reference an asset that already exists, with alt text describing what it carries.

requires: an existing asset id with alt text
unique label ids
every label target declared against the asset
negative_cases: targets estimated from an unrelated image

asset_requirements.identity: An existing asset id. An unresolved asset is a tracked dependency, not a blank render.
asset_requirements.coordinate_system: named targets bound to the asset; positions not authorable today

simulation-block.purpose: Manipulate a variable and discover the concept through observation

field_guidance.spec.type: Discriminator string for the embedded interaction. Format: plain_text. Plain text token consumed by the interaction host.
field_guidance.spec.goal: Human-readable learning goal for the interaction. Format: plain_text. Plain text summary line.
field_guidance.spec.anchor_content: Structured anchor parameters for the interaction. Format: structured_object. Arbitrary JSON object interpreted by the interaction renderer.
field_guidance.spec.context: Visual context for the interaction (theme, colors, learner level). Format: structured_object. Passed to the interaction shell for styling and layout.
field_guidance.spec.dimensions: Width/height hints for the iframe surface. Format: structured_object. Controls iframe sizing hints.
field_guidance.spec.print_translation: How the interaction degrades in print (static snapshot, hide, etc.). Format: enum.
field_guidance.html_content: Optional HTML bundle for iframe embedding. Format: plain_text. Trusted HTML inserted into the sandboxed iframe host.
field_guidance.fallback_diagram: Optional DiagramContent used when iframe content is unavailable. Format: structured_object. Rendered with DiagramBlock semantics.
field_guidance.explanation: Optional instructor-facing explanation of the interaction. Format: inline_markdown. Inline markdown helper text.

requires: Provide either html_content or a meaningful fallback_diagram for offline contexts.
Keep spec.goal aligned with what the iframe interaction practices.

spec.goal: Explore the slider effect on the graph.

asset_requirements.identity: An existing asset id; media components never describe an unproduced asset.

answer-key.purpose: Provides correct answers with misconception evidence for each diagnostic distractor

field_guidance.label: Optional heading; defaults to "Answer key". Format: plain_text_short. Plain text heading.
field_guidance.note: Optional standing note beneath the heading. Format: plain_text. Defaults to the standard indicative-not-conclusive diagnostic note.
field_guidance.entries[].question_number: Source question number used for ordered-list numbering. Format: number.
field_guidance.entries[].question: Full question stem repeated for standalone use. Format: plain_text. Plain text that wraps without truncation.
field_guidance.entries[].correct_key: Optional source option key such as "a". Format: plain_text_short.
field_guidance.entries[].diagnostics[].option_text: Incorrect option text selected by a learner. Format: plain_text.
field_guidance.entries[].diagnostics[].misconception_id: Caller-supplied misconception id; Lectio does not interpret it. Format: plain_text_short.

requires: Use evidence language: chose "{option_text}" → consistent with: {misconception_label}.
Never describe a diagnostic tag as a confirmed learner belief.
Do not deduplicate repeated misconception ids; consumers own aggregation.

entries.question: A tree gains 50 kg of wood. Where did most of that mass come from?
